verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party serverless compute offering: the AWS docs index lists a service to "Run code without thinking about servers," and AgentCore docs mention calling a Lambda function. A tutorial also builds a serverless web app with Amplify. Beyond these thin mentions, nothing in the pack documents the specifics the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented event triggers, documented execution limits (timeouts, memory, concurrency), cold-start behavior documentation, serverless containers option, independent or hands-on corroboration.
